notes.title: Midnight Horde Demo
notes.notes:
[b]Midnight Horde Demo Celebration: Patch Notes[/b]


Thank you for playing the demo of [i]Midnight Horde[/i]! Your feedback has helped me shape the game into a better experience, and I'm thrilled to share all the updates I have made based on the feedback. Here’s a summary of all the new features, balance changes, and fixes I implemented based on your input. 

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tooltips for better clarity:
  - On popup unlocks in the main menu.
  - On chest rewards.
  - In the inventory during level-up.
[*] Introduced a Gold quest: Stay alive for 1 minute to earn gold earlier.
[*] Added a gold-spawning building.
[*] All pickups like heal or summon-all-xp now recharge.
[*] Improved castle building selection and zoom focus on the selected piece.
[*] Enhanced level socket readability and appearance.
[*] Updated the power-up menu to make it juicier.
[*] Power-ups you can afford are now highlighted.
[*] Added a new sound for the winning screen.
[/list]


[h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Spread bosses out more evenly and nerfed certain events.
[*] Skull boss eyes now have increased HP when they drop out.
[*] Reduced many power-up menu stat costs by up to 50%.
[*] The red XP now slowly moves toward the player.
[*] Introduced a new difficulty scaling system where perk upgrades increase enemy HP by 35% instead of 50%.
[*] Lowered the number of upgrades for many stats during a run to allow for faster synergy unlocks.
[*] Out-of-map teleport now:
  - Pushes enemies away.
  - Makes the player invulnerable for 1 second.
[*] Death from Above now triggers on normal falling as well.
[*] Nerfed Explosive Monster speed.
[*] Made it easier to get more chest rewards when repeatedly earning them.
[/list]



[h2][b]Readability Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Monsters are now dark until they finish climbing.
[*] Heavy Landing now features more particles and a new sound effect.
[*] Out-of-map teleport slows down time and shows damage before teleporting.
[/list]


[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug that doubled power-up stats when upgrading again.
[*] Reduced lag caused by ghosts.
[*] Explosion Monster damage radius now matches the visible explosion.
[*] Fixed Speed Bullets incorrectly pointing to Machine Gun as an evolved state.
[*] Winning menu updates correctly now.
[*] Fixed the 20-minute quest goal not triggering.
[*] Improved localization for Roman numerals.
[*] Adjusted settings menu for better usability.
[*] Reduced shakiness of the Rod of God.
[*] Fixed splash screen resolution issues.
[*] Fixed number scrolling and text alignment issues in the castle builder.
[*] Resolved Steam Cloud save issues.
[/list]

 
I hope the demo has been fun! 
I got a lot of new energy watching people play the game.

I will let the demo stay up for at least a month more.
But for now I will try to wind down the updates and try to take some holiday vacation.

All the best
Per

notes.title: Midnight Horde development Update 1
notes.notes:
Greeting and salutations!

I have been hard at work this year making the game feel good and fresh! 

Hopefully I will have a demo ready to share soon!

In the meantime I want to take the time to share two new enemies I am working on.
One cool thing to me is that I am doing a lot of the animations inside the shaders, both idle and "locomotion" wise.

1. Explosion boi, is the stereotypical get close explode sort of baneling. Which I find very satisfying and scary in most games.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43673185/ab2ea0e2c6d9f02c5b89e2e26078bf50fd898924.gif[/img]

2. Next up is long long boi, I have not yet decided all of his features but I am thinking his arms could come for you faster than his movement speed. Giving you a little jump scare.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43673185/787980826f9bc48ae9ea47e37ac269dbcdb4f3e9.gif[/img]

I have also been working on making buildings more important to the game. 
Powerful tools to be used at the right moment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43673185/b2b40d75482bc07529ec8c192c6481c73780a58b.gif[/img]


I have also added a mini map to easier see the overwhelming numbers and where you are on the castle.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43673185/af4db780b22a6f4691f605d4fcf809461137d062.png[/img]



I feel like I should be sharing more of my development here, so if there is something you are interested in getting a look behind the scenes at, I am all ears. 


I appreciate all feedback that I can get.

Kind regards
Per

notes.title: Day 1 for Midnight Horde
notes.notes:
Hello,

This is blog post nr 1 for Midnight Horde and I am happy you have taken the time to check it out.

Midnight Horde is the result of me playing a lot of Vampire Survivors, 20 minutes till dawn and Dead Cells. 

The setting is heavily inspired by Mike Mignola and I did get the idea by reading one of his comics and thought that it should be a game. I will also take a lot of inspiration from Blade, Vampire Hunter D and Hellsing.


Midnight horde will be a lightweight platformer in the sense that it will not be a struggle but a tool to kite the enemies. I plan the weapons to be inspired by witch hunter type of weapons, early ww1 weapons and contraptions. These will be similar to 20 minute till dawn and Vampire Survivors with synergy fusing upgrades.


This is the perfect time to give your feedback about what you like or dislike or feature requests. It will be possible to ask during the early access as well but until that is released it will be easier to mold the game in this phase.

One of the first things I want to experiment with and have not nailed is how the castle progression will look like. I have a couple of options that I like:

1. Static upgrade, like a puzzle complete the castle linear progression
2. You get pieces but can place them anywhere.
3. More like a deck builder, a card is a building piece and you could compose new castles based on how many slots they take with some resource restrictions. This could allow you to rebuild and restructure the castle after every fight to fine tune it to your playstyle. The cons of this is that it will be harder to balance and it might look ugly at times and make the player create boring solutions.

One of the more interesting tech I will dig into for this game is flow field pathfinding that I think will create some optimized and interesting movement for the enemies!


I would say this game is in a very early stage and the reason I am publishing this steampage is to keep myself accountable and get early feedback.

Regards
Per
